title: 2'-O-Galloylhyperin attenuates osteoclastogenesis and estrogen-deficiency osteoporosis by targeting MLK3-mediated NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: He, Gaolu; Chen, Ruihan; Fang, Zhiyu; Fu, Siyi; Wang, Yuzhe; Li, Hengzhi; Hu, Pengfei; Bao, Jiapeng; Ran, Jisheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮衍生物通过靶向MLK3抑制破骨细胞生成和骨质疏松，核心是蛋白-小分子互作与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与课题无关。
abstract: Estrogen deficiency-induced osteoporosis is largely driven by excessive osteoclast formation and bone resorption, but the direct pharmacological targets of flavonoid derivatives in osteoclast differentiation remain unclear. Here, we investigated the anti-osteoclastogenic activity and molecular mechanism of 2'-O-Galloylhyperin (2'-O-GH), a structurally defined flavonoid derivative. The effects of 2'-O-GH on RANKL-induced osteoclastogenesis were evaluated in bone marrow-derived macrophages and RAW264.7 cells using TRAP staining, qPCR, western blotting, F-actin staining, immunofluorescence, and bone resorption assays. Target identification was performed using a biotinylated 2'-O-GH probe coupled with pull-down and LC-MS/MS analysis, followed by molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis. In vivo efficacy was assessed in an ovariectomy-induced osteoporosis mouse model. 2'-O-GH inhibited RANKL-induced formation of TRAP-positive multinucleated osteoclasts without evident cytotoxicity at effective concentrations. It downregulated osteoclast-related markers, including NFATc1, c-FOS, SRC, ACP5, ATP6V0D2, and CTSK, and impaired F-actin ring formation and bone resorption. Mechanistically, 2'-O-GH restrained RANKL-induced NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation. Chemical proteomics identified MAP3K11/MLK3 as a candidate target, and molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis supported its direct interaction with 2'-O-GH. 2'-O-GH further suppressed RANKL-induced phosphorylation of MLK3 and IKKalpha/beta, whereas MLK3 overexpression partially rescued NF-kappaB activation and osteoclast differentiation. In ovariectomized mice, 2'-O-GH attenuated bone loss without obvious effects on body or uterine weight. These findings identify MLK3 as a pharmacological target of 2'-O-GH and suggest that 2'-O-GH suppresses osteoclastogenesis through the MLK3/IKK/NF-kappaB axis.
abstract_zh: 雌激素缺乏诱导的骨质疏松主要由过度破骨细胞形成和骨吸收驱动，但类黄酮衍生物在破骨细胞分化中的直接药理学靶点仍不清楚。在此，我们研究了结构明确的类黄酮衍生物2'-O-没食子酰基金丝桃苷（2'-O-Galloylhyperin, 2'-O-GH）的抗破骨细胞生成活性及其分子机制。在骨髓来源巨噬细胞和RAW264.7细胞中，通过TRAP染色、qPCR、western blotting、F-actin染色、免疫荧光和骨吸收实验评估了2'-O-GH对RANKL诱导的破骨细胞生成的影响。靶点鉴定使用生物素化的2'-O-GH探针结合pull-down和LC-MS/MS分析，随后进行分子对接和微量热泳动实验。体内疗效在卵巢切除诱导的骨质疏松小鼠模型中评估。2'-O-GH在有效浓度下抑制RANKL诱导的TRAP阳性多核破骨细胞形成，且无明显细胞毒性。它下调了破骨细胞相关标志物，包括NFATc1、c-FOS、SRC、ACP5、ATP6V0D2和CTSK，并损害了F-actin环形成和骨吸收。机制上，2'-O-GH抑制了RANKL诱导的NF-kappaB p65核转位。化学蛋白质组学鉴定出MAP3K11/MLK3为候选靶点，分子对接和微量热泳动支持其与2'-O-GH的直接相互作用。2'-O-GH进一步抑制了RANKL诱导的MLK3和IKKalpha/beta磷酸化，而MLK3过表达部分挽救了NF-kappaB激活和破骨细胞分化。在卵巢切除小鼠中，2'-O-GH减轻了骨丢失，且对体重或子宫重量无明显影响。这些发现将MLK3确定为2'-O-GH的药理学靶点，并提示2'-O-GH通过MLK3/IKK/NF-kappaB轴抑制破骨细胞生成。
